posts.author: passmoreNOPE
posts.body:
Hi there! I just wanted to make an introduction thread. I got RPG Maker VX Ace back during covid and played around with it a bit. Now I've got the creative itch again, so I downloaded MZ and got back to it. Taking some unfinished ideas from a few years ago and giving them a lot of polish.
Right now I'm working on a battle system involving some enemies being armored and you having to break their armor to open them up to attacks. Hoping to make it fun and strategic. I'll be sure to make a post for it once I'm a little further along. Looking forward to posting more on here!

Looks like you joined a long, long time ago. Thanks for saying hi!

posts.author: Roocifer
posts.body: Welcome back to the forum! The armored system is a fun mechanic I've enjoyed playing Zelda titles so I hope you can get it to work! Make sure to share your progress so we can see!

posts.author: passmoreNOPE
posts.body:
Wow, I do not remember joining the forums back in 2014. I guess I was playing around with RPG Maker way back then. Well since then I've had 3 kids and lived through covid, so may as well have been a few lifetimes ago!
I'll be sure to get a progress post going as soon as I've gotten a sort of minimum viable product with the first area and a few fights to go through.
Right now I'm polishing up the battle system and I've done some minimal mapping and eventing. Thank you all for the kind welcome, hope to make that post soon!
